sourceBindings.text: Examples include apple, orange, grape, strawberry, blueberry and banana. A fruit in botanical terms develops from a flower; the practical fruit-crop group is about production and use. Many orchard trees and vines stay in the ground for years, but these six examples do not all share the same plant form or management cycle. Strawberry and banana especially show why 'every fruit is a tree or bush' is false.
